Landing.title: Build a clear route to a Korean university
Landing.subtitle: Verify official requirements, compare programs, track documents and deadlines, and turn your profile into an actionable preparation plan.
Landing.trustText: UniRoute never predicts an admission probability. Every important value shows its source, verification date, and whether it is official, estimated, or still unconfirmed.
Landing.forTitle: Designed for students before the process feels obvious
Landing.forText: For grades 9–11, recent graduates, and Russian-speaking international applicants who need a reliable structure for South Korea.
Landing.toolsTitle: One workspace for the entire application
Landing.toolDiscoveryText: Filter a focused set of South Korean universities and open the official source behind each claim.
Landing.toolPlanningText: Convert target intakes into suggested milestones and keep official dates clearly separate.
Landing.toolReadinessText: See what meets a stated requirement, what needs work, and where the source still requires verification.
Landing.previewTitle: A roadmap that changes with your goal
Landing.previewSubtitle: Example for a Fall 2027 bachelor’s applicant
Landing.disclaimer: UniRoute Korea is an organizational and informational tool. It is not a university, admissions officer, visa authority, or guarantee of admission.

Privacy.title: Privacy notice
Privacy.intro: UniRoute Korea minimizes personal data and separates public admission information from private planning records.
Privacy.collect: The profile stores planning preferences, approximate academic and language information, budgets, tasks, document metadata, shortlist data, and notes. We do not request passport numbers, bank details, precise home addresses, or identity document files.
Privacy.guest: Guest data stays in this browser’s local storage. It is not synced and may be lost if site data is cleared. Export it from Settings before changing devices.
Privacy.account: When Supabase is configured and you sign in, personal records are protected by Row Level Security and scoped to your authenticated user ID. The public anon key is not a secret; the service-role key remains server-only.
Privacy.files: The MVP stores document names, status, dates, and notes only. It does not upload admission documents. A future file feature must use private storage, signed URLs, validation, and storage policies before launch.
Privacy.rights: Settings let you export personal data, clear guest data, reset onboarding, and request account deletion. Email reminders are off until explicit consent.
Privacy.service: UniRoute Korea is an organizational and informational tool, not a university, admissions representative, legal adviser, or visa authority.
